:::{#exr-subspace-equal-dim-practice}
#### Showing that a span of two vectors is all of $\reals^2$

@thm-subspace-equal-dim shows that two [subspaces](#def-subspace) coincide
by comparing [dimensions](#def-dimension) instead of checking every vector.
Let

$$
\mathcal{T} = \operatorname{span}\cb{\tp{(1, 2)},\ \tp{(3, 1)}}.
$$

Is $\mathcal{T}$ all of $\reals^2$?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Find $\dim(\mathcal{T})$ and $\dim(\reals^2)$,
then use @thm-subspace-equal-dim with $\mathcal{S} = \reals^2$.

:::

:::
